annotations.title: Workspace Quota, BYOK Vault & Billing Status

description: Inspect the active Argosor workspace subscription tier, remaining monthly query quota, USD credit ledger balance, and configured BYOK credentials. Use this tool before running large batch audits to verify available quota, active API keys, or encrypted provider connections. Returns workspace plan details, real-time usage counters, masked API key metadata, and BYOK vault status.

include_api_keys.description: When true, lists active API keys and prefixes belonging to the workspace (default: true).

include_byok_vault.description: When true, lists encrypted BYOK provider credentials configured in the workspace vault (default: true).
